lore: Most of the brigade only notices Harvest Audit Report when something is missing, which is exactly the point. Harvest Audit Report scouts inbound supply, checks stock levels against par and secures the route for every ingredient the line depends on; the image the crew uses for it is the loading dock before dawn.
